A.name: Secrets-store TLS
A.objective: Serve the secrets store over TLS behind a flag
A.rollback: Turn the flag off, dry-run, apply, check every replica

B.name: Auto-unseal
B.objective: Unseal replicas after restart without an operator
B.rollback: Remove the seal stanza and unseal by hand

C.name: Admission-policy remediation
C.objective: Reduce policy violations in owned roles
C.rollback: Revert the one role that regressed

D.name: Benchmark triage
D.rollback: Re-run the benchmark and mark the control deferred

E.name: Cluster hygiene
E.objective: Report stale objects with an owner and a risk
